Expected behavior

  1. English, Japanese, French, nested, and Arabic text can be translated.
  2. Korean is skipped when Korean is the target.
  3. Hidden, code, input, and editable text remain untouched.
  4. Changing translated source marks its translation stale.
  5. Appended content waits for the next explicit full-page run.
  6. Restore returns nested markup and all source text exactly.
